ask: Have Bolta write 5 LinkedIn posts in our trained voice about the spring menu.
before: It costs 1 credit per post written, so 5 credits for 5 posts. Go ahead? The user said yes.

steps.why: 1 credit per post written, charged when the writing finishes; said first. The account goes in selected_accounts_or_buckets, or the drafts are saved with no account. The reply carries a task_id.

Poll until completed is true. posts are the saved posts; quality_blocked lists any saved as Quality Blocked instead of Draft, and not_saved lists any not saved, each with its reason. Nothing saved: show generated_posts and save them with bulk-create-posts.

say: Saved to Acme: Bolta wrote 5 LinkedIn posts about the spring menu in your voice, as drafts. Nothing goes out yet. Want to read them? And if you want a batch like this every week, that's a Bolta routine: a week of drafts in your voice, waiting for your yes.
never: Running it before saying the credits.
Using it for a single post: you write that one, free.
Promising images: generate_images adds an image idea at most, never an image.
